Indian Companies Report Mixed Financial Results for Q1 FY27

Several Indian companies have released their financial results for the first quarter of FY27, showing varied performance. While some firms reported significant jumps in revenue and profit, others experienced declines or missed estimates. Key sectors like IT, financial services, and hospitality have presented a mixed financial picture for the quarter.
